verdict.rationale: Data portability is a fair question for an identity-verification SaaS, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no bulk export or open-format download that would let a customer take all their data and leave. API polling for statuses and verification details is only a developer building block, and Connect sharing between Persona organizations is an adjacent feature; neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
